content.text: {"suggestions":[{"title":"Teacher Appreciation Cork Coasters","summary":"Round cork coasters decorated with cheerful vinyl phrases and simple flower or apple motifs, perfect for teacher gifts or classroom fundraisers.","whyItFits":"Uses your cork coasters and vinyl sheets, stays within your fine-point blade and matches the home-decor/teacher theme without any licensed characters or logos.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":150,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-20","amount":1,"unit":"piece"},{"supplyId":"sup-01","amount":0.15,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":0.3,"unit":"ft"},{"supplyId":"sup-26","amount":0.05,"unit":"piece"}],"missing":[{"item":"Extra cork coasters (8 more needed for 20 total)","why":"You only have 12 on hand; need 8 more to reach 20 finished pieces","estCost":"$4"}],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design a simple word or icon (like 'Best Teacher' or a small apple/flower) in your cutting software, sized to fit a 4 in coaster","Cut the design from vinyl using the fine-point blade","Weed away the extra vinyl with a hook or tweezers","Apply transfer tape over the design and lift it from the backing","Press the design onto the coaster, smoothing out air bubbles","Peel off the transfer tape and let the coaster sit flat overnight before use"],"designTips":"Search for 'quote coaster template' or 'minimalist flower silhouette' in your design software. Keep designs simple and small so they read well on a 4 inch circle. Use the 'weld' tool if you combine text with a small icon.","sellInfo":{"unitCostEst":"$0.90","priceLow":"$4","priceHigh":"$7","batchNotes":"Sell as sets of 4 for better margins; bundle with ribbon for a gift-ready look."},"safetyNotes":["Vinyl coasters are for coffee cups or plants, not food contact—keep the decorated side away from food.","Cork can absorb moisture over time; suggest customers hand-wipe rather than soak."]},{"title":"Printable Motivational Sticker Sheets","summary":"Sheets of small stickers with encouraging phrases and simple line-art icons (books, coffee cups, plants) for teachers, students, or planner lovers.","whyItFits":"Uses your printable sticker paper and inkjet printer with Print Then Cut, needs no extra purchases, and fits the teacher/home-decor angle perfectly.","difficulty":1,"estMinutes":120,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-13","amount":0.05,"unit":"sheet"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":["inkjet-printer"],"steps":["Arrange 15-20 small sticker designs (phrases, coffee cups, books, plants) on one 8.5x11 sheet in your design software","Print the sheet on your inkjet printer using the printable sticker paper","Load the printed sheet onto your mat and use Print Then Cut so the machine finds the registration marks","Let the fine-point blade cut around each sticker shape","Peel the stickers off the mat and stack them into little sets for sale"],"designTips":"Search 'Print Then Cut sticker sheet' in your software. Use simple line-art icons and readable fonts; a light color background helps stickers stand out. Group items close together to save paper.","sellInfo":{"unitCostEst":"$0.15","priceLow":"$3","priceHigh":"$6","batchNotes":"Sell as themed sticker sheets (one sheet = one listing) rather than single stickers for better margin per printed page."},"safetyNotes":["Stickers are small parts—keep away from children under 3.","Sticker paper is not washable or food-safe; avoid placing on dishes or mugs that touch food."]},{"title":"Cozy Home Tote Bags","summary":"Canvas tote bags with warm home-decor phrases or simple botanical line art, great for gift shops or online home-goods listings.","whyItFits":"Uses your cotton totes, iron-on vinyl, and household iron; fits the home-decor theme, and the iron-on application is a skill you already have covered by your Maker 5 cutting tool.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":200,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-18","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-06","amount":0.5,"unit":"sheet"}],"missing":[{"item":"Extra cotton tote bags (15 more needed for a batch of 20)","why":"You only have 5 totes; need 15 more for a full batch of 20 finished bags","estCost":"$45 (about $3 each)"}],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":["household-iron"],"steps":["Design a short cozy phrase (like 'Home Is Where the Heart Is') or a simple leaf/branch motif, mirrored for iron-on","Cut the design from iron-on vinyl using the fine-point blade, shiny side down","Weed away the extra material, keeping just your design","Preheat the household iron on a cotton setting with no steam","Place the design on the tote, cover with a thin cloth, and press firmly for 20-30 seconds, moving the iron in sections","Let it cool, then peel back the carrier sheet slowly"],"designTips":"Search 'cozy home phrase svg' or 'simple botanical line art' in your design software. Use the 'mirror' tool before cutting iron-on. Keep designs about 8-9 inches wide to center nicely on the tote.","sellInfo":{"unitCostEst":"$4.50","priceLow":"$14","priceHigh":"$22","batchNotes":"Totes with iron-on designs sell well as a set of 2 (his/hers or matching pair); consider bundling with a coaster for an at-home gift set."},"safetyNotes":["Iron gets very hot—keep it away from children and always place it on its heel rest when not moving.","Wash finished totes inside out on cold, gentle cycle to protect the design; avoid high heat dryers."]}],"note":"I skipped Disney princesses and NFL team logos since those are trademarked/copyrighted and can't legally be sold. Instead I leaned into your home-decor and teacher-gift interests with original phrases and simple icons that are safe to sell and still make a charming, giftable collection."}
